item.title: Version 3.0.1
item.description:
MindExtract 3.0.1

  • A new introduction you do, not read. Open the notch yourself, hear a short sample become text, then paste it.
  • Show All in Finder at the end of Recent.
  • ⌘V always lands in the notch, even with several screens and apps open.

Want to see the new introduction? Settings, About, Introduction, Show Again.
